text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What's it take to be an adult?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After asking for more details, I learn that her question was triggered by a certain incident that unfolded yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, I can't wait to see the baby whale!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's the ticket booth. 'Scuse me, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Ticket Staff
text_block_list.text: Two tickets with the kids' discount?

text_block_list.name: Inari and Tamamo
text_block_list.text: …Kids?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Do we look like kids?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll admit I'm kinda on the small side, but still!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: How could anyone see such bold, mature Umamusume and mistake 'em for some grade-school babies?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …I mean, we genuinely are too old for the kids discount.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But we gotta face the facts—that ticket seller thought we were kids. We gotta calm down and think this through.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We figured we'd get an adult's input, and you're the closest one I've got on deck!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So whaddya think? Is it the way we act? How we talk? Our looks? Lay it on us.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What do we gotta do to start givin' off some real adult vibes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's not the easiest question to answer, but the first thing that comes to mind is…
choice_data_list: Adults are good at handling themselves!
Adults are good at saving money!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Handlin' ourselves, eh? Ya mean like handlin' everythin' without relyin' on others to help ya?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But we just relied on…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, let's just try it first!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: First up, we gotta get ourselves up and outta bed to start the day! Good mooornin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And a good amount of exercise makes for a healthy lifestyle! Just like with trainin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I gotta prepare my own meals! And I also gotta balance the food groups out, without bein' picky. Bon appetit!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is just my regular routine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But doesn't that mean we've been adults all along?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it does. Can't believe I was sweatin' somethin' so small. That was way outta character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the problem resolving on its own, Tamamo Cross and Inari One saunter outside looking completely at ease.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Savings? Well, I already got some savings, but… is that really what bein' an adult's all about?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Well, whatever. Since it's comin' from you, I might as well give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, so all I gotta do is pile up some savin's! Time to get the cash rollin' in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come one, come all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: For a limited time, one servin' of takoyaki is just 250 yen! Save by getting two for 400 yen!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's the takoyaki everyone's been raving about! Excuse me, could I get two servings?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'll take four—no, make that six!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Much appreciated! At this rate, we'll be sold out in no time!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gettin' sales numbers like these in a single day is nothin' to sniff at! No doubt about it, we're definitely real adults now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wahahaha! This is practically Tracen's kitchen now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the two get chewed out by Air Groove, who stops by to investigate all the noise… but that's a story for another day.
